old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a wood-burning stove, focusing on its top surface where steam and smoke are visibly rising from the hot metal. The stove's surface is dark gray, with a cylindrical chimney protruding from the center. As the video progresses, white ash or residue is seen being dispersed across the surface by the rising steam and smoke. The camera remains static, and the background features a wooden wall, indicating an indoor setting. The steam continues to rise, emphasizing the heat and activity of the stove. The overall scene suggests a cozy, rustic environment, likely a cabin or a similar setting.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a wood-burning stove, focusing on its top surface where steam and smoke are visibly rising from the hot metal. The stove's surface is dark gray, with a cylindrical chimney protruding from the center. As the video progresses, water droplets are seen splashing onto the stove's surface, creating small splashes and mist. The camera pans slightly to the left, revealing more of the stove's structure, including a black handle and a circular emblem on the front. The background features a wooden wall and part of a door, indicating an indoor setting. The steam continues to rise, and the water droplets continue to splash, emphasizing the heat and activity of the stove. The overall scene suggests a cozy, rustic environment, likely a cabin or a similar setting.
caption: The video captures a close view of the flat dark-gray top of a stove-like metal appliance, with a black cylindrical flue pipe rising from the center-back and a small brass fitting on the front lip against wooden paneling. A white wet-looking patch with a horizontal streak sits on the left of the top, while scattered white specks dot the rest of the surface. Above that patch a fountain of fine droplets is already erupting, growing taller and denser and brightening the white area beneath it. Wispy vapor swirls around the pipe base and drifts across the right side. The framing slowly shifts leftward, revealing the black cable loop and a pale wall at the far left while the pipe slides toward the right edge. The scattered specks persist, their pattern subtly shifting as droplets land. The spray and vapor continue without settling as the excerpt ends.

If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
